name: accountable
description: Accountable: a sales CRM, the first part of a business OS

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,green "uv run uvicorn accountable.main:app --port 8000 --reload --reload-dir backend/accountable" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.types: uv run python -m accountable.openapi frontend/openapi.json && npm run types -w frontend
scripts.types:check: uv run python -m accountable.openapi frontend/openapi.json && npm run types:check -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run types:check && npm run typecheck -w frontend && npm run typecheck:e2e && npm run test -w frontend && uv run pytest && playwright test
